title: Selling Plans — Tenure Lookback on Repaid Annual-Term Charges
content:
When a **Selling Plans** store moves from the annual to the monthly term, the number of regular annual-term subscription charges the term change fee repays depends on how long ago the seller's selling plan was verified.

**Rule.** The number of regular charges repaid in a term change fee is capped by a lookback: only the long-tenure lookback count of charges is repaid when the selling plan was verified at least the long tenure months before the decision date, only the mid-tenure lookback count when it was verified at least the mid tenure months but fewer than the long tenure months before, and every regular charge of the current term otherwise, the tenure being counted in whole months.

## Lookback by tenure

| Whole months from the plan's verification date to the decision date | Regular charges of the current term repaid |
|---|---|
| 36 or more (the long tenure months) | At most 3 (the long-tenure lookback): the term's regular charges, but never more than 3 |
| 24 or more but fewer than 36 (the mid tenure months up to the long) | At most 6 (the mid-tenure lookback): the term's regular charges, but never more than 6 |
| Fewer than 24 | Every regular charge of the current term |

## Applying the cap (hypothetical counts)

| Regular charges in the current term | Tenure | Charges repaid |
|---|---|---|
| 8 | 40 whole months | 3 |
| 2 | 40 whole months | 2 — fewer than the cap of 3 |
| 8 | 30 whole months | 6 |
| 8 | 20 whole months | 8 |

## Whole months, both sides (plan verified on 15 March 2023)

- Decision on 15 March 2026: 36 whole months, cap of 3.
- Decision on 14 March 2026: 35 whole months, cap of 6.
- Decision on 14 March 2025: 23 whole months, no cap.
